name: Boardgame AI Tools
description: In-process dsh tools for the boardgame machine-playable API: create/read matches, list legal actions, submit actions and evaluate positions. Zero external dependencies and no network calls.

errorCodes.E_UNKNOWN_TOOL: The requested tool name is not registered by this plugin.
errorCodes.E_INVALID_ARGS: Tool arguments are missing or have the wrong type.
errorCodes.E_UNSUPPORTED_GAME: The requested game is not supported.
errorCodes.E_MATCH_NOT_FOUND: No in-memory match exists for the given matchId.
errorCodes.E_ILLEGAL_ACTION: The action type is unknown or illegal for the current state.
errorCodes.E_NOT_YOUR_TURN: The action was submitted for a player who is not on turn.
errorCodes.E_INVALID_PLAYER: The player index is out of range.
errorCodes.E_CARD_NOT_IN_HAND: The requested card is not in that player's hand.
errorCodes.E_NO_ACTIVE: The player has no Active Pokemon for this action.
